description: This file contains unit tests for the JSON serialization of Orleans types, including GrainId and various collection types, using Xunit. It verifies that serialization and deserialization produce expected equivalents.

classes.name: JsonSerializerTests
classes.description: Unit test class for testing JSON serialization of Orleans GrainId types and collections.

methods.name: Serialization_GrainId_RoundTrip
methods.description: Tests serialization and deserialization round-trip for GrainId instance.

methods.name: Serialization_WithGrainIdType_RoundTrip
methods.description: Tests serialization and deserialization round-trip for WithGrainIdType containing a GrainId.

methods.name: Serialization_WithGrainIdMapType_RoundTrip
methods.description: Tests serialization and deserialization round-trip for WithGrainIdMapType containing a Dictionary of GrainId.

methods.name: Serialization_WithGrainIdConcurrentDictionaryType_RoundTrip
methods.description: Tests serialization and deserialization round-trip for WithGrainIdMapType containing a ConcurrentDictionary of GrainId.

methods.name: Serialization_WithGrainIdHashSetType_RoundTrip
methods.description: Tests serialization and deserialization round-trip for WithGrainIdSetType containing a HashSet of GrainId.
